name: In Vitro Shoujo -Habatakishi Torikago no Tenshi-
original_name: 淫靡蕩少女――羽ばたきし鳥かごの天使――
source:
The main character, “Tenmaru Kokoromo”, woke up in a cold sleep in a research facility.
Three hundred and fifty years had passed since Tenmaru had fallen asleep.
At the facility, he meets, “Roselle,” a winged sexaroid, and, “Dia,” an android who manages the facility.
The three tried to get out, but the door was tightly closed and they could not get out.
They have only two weeks' worth of food left.
They form an irreplaceable bond in the closed research facility.
A huge facility, artificial girls, and mysterious figures.
The hidden truth forces them to make a heartless choice.

[Translated from [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/58dlsite2/story.html]the official site[/url]]
translation:
主角“天丸心物”在研究设施的寒冷睡眠中醒来。
自从天丸沉睡以来，已经过去了三百五十年。
在该设施中，他遇到了“Roselle”，一个有翅膀的性爱机器人，以及“Dia”，一个管理该设施的机器人。
三人试图出去，但门紧闭，他们无法出去。
他们只剩下两周的食物了。
他们在封闭的研究设施中形成了不可替代的纽带。
巨大的设施、人造少女、神秘人物。
隐藏的真相迫使他们做出无情的选择。

[翻译自[url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/58dlsite2/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
